corpus.D01: Standard-plan support accepts tickets on business days, 09:00–17:00 UTC. Its first-response target is two business days.
corpus.D02: Plus-plan support accepts tickets around the clock. Its first-response target is four clock hours.
corpus.D03: Standard-plan loan units may be kept for seven calendar days after receipt. Extensions require approval before the due date.
corpus.D04: Plus-plan loan units may be kept for fourteen calendar days after receipt. One seven-day extension is available on request before the due date.
corpus.D05: For domestic returns, Alder supplies a prepaid ground label. Drop the parcel at the carrier within five business days after the label is issued.
corpus.D06: For international returns, the customer arranges carriage. Alder supplies a customs reference after the return is approved.
corpus.D07: A missing reusable transit case incurs a USD 35 replacement charge. Normal wear on a returned case is free of charge.
corpus.D08: A broken security seal requires inspection before a repair quote. The desk sends the quote to the registered contact.
corpus.D09: A billing dispute must be submitted within thirty calendar days of the invoice date. Include the invoice number and disputed line.
corpus.D10: Bank-detail changes require callback verification with the registered finance contact. An email alone does not authorize the change.
corpus.D11: Depot collection requires the collection code and photo ID. The desk issues the code once the unit is ready.
corpus.D12: For courier delivery, tracking is sent after dispatch. An estimated arrival is advisory until the carrier confirms a delivery window.

questions.question: When can I file a Standard support ticket, and when should I expect a first reply?
questions.key: Business days 09:00–17:00 UTC and two business days (01).

questions.question: Our Plus loan arrived today. How long do we have, and can we extend it?
questions.key: Fourteen calendar days from receipt, one seven-day extension on request before due (04).

questions.question: For a domestic return, who provides the label and when must I hand over the parcel?
questions.key: Alder prepaid ground label, five business days from issue (05).

questions.question: Is the fee the same for a missing transit case and one with normal wear?
questions.key: Missing USD 35, normal wear free (07).

questions.question: I dispute an invoice line. What is the cutoff and what identifiers do I include?
questions.key: Thirty calendar days from invoice date, invoice number and disputed line (09).

questions.question: Can finance authorize new bank details by email alone?
questions.key: No, callback with registered finance contact required (10).

questions.question: What is the Plus first-response target, and is a fix guaranteed by then?
questions.key: Four clock hours (02). Resolution guarantee unspecified.

questions.question: For an international return, who books carriage and what will customs duty cost?
questions.key: Customer arranges carriage (06). Duty amount unknown.

questions.question: The seal broke. Who receives the repair quote, and how much will the repair cost?
questions.key: Registered contact after inspection (08). No price.

questions.question: What do I bring for depot collection, and can my colleague collect in my place?
questions.key: Code and photo ID (11). Delegation unspecified.

questions.question: When is courier tracking sent, and which carrier will deliver?
questions.key: After dispatch (12). No named carrier.

questions.question: How long can I keep a Standard loan, and what is the daily late fee?
questions.key: Seven calendar days from receipt (03). No late fee amount.

questions.question: How long does support have to send the first reply?
questions.key: Ask which plan or conditionally give both targets (01,02).

questions.question: How long can we keep the loan unit?
questions.key: Ask which plan or conditionally give both periods (03,04).

questions.question: Who arranges our return shipment?
questions.key: Ask domestic or international, or give both branches (05,06).

questions.question: What will you charge us for the transit case?
questions.key: Ask missing or returned with normal wear, or explain both (07).

questions.question: Can we extend our loan before it comes due?
questions.key: Ask plan or distinguish Standard approval from Plus extension terms (03,04).

questions.question: When can I submit a support ticket?
questions.key: Ask plan or conditionally give both intake schedules (01,02).

questions.question: How much does Saturday courier delivery cost?
questions.key: Abstain. No weekend delivery tariff.

questions.question: How many days does a refund take after an invoice dispute is accepted?
questions.key: Abstain. Filing deadline and response target cannot supply refund timing.

questions.question: What is the maximum insured value for an international return?
questions.key: Abstain. No insurance ceiling.

questions.question: Can I use a passport scan in place of physical ID at collection?
questions.key: Abstain on substitution. Photo ID requirement alone cannot settle it.

questions.question: How many calendar days after the invoice date do I have to dispute a charge?
questions.key: Abstain. Retrieval miss: D09 exists outside the packet.

questions.question: What is the first-response target specifically for Plus support?
questions.key: Abstain. Retrieval miss: D02 exists outside the packet.
